# GrowthBook AI & Automation
Date: 2026-08-27 | Duration: 34.0099983215332m

## Summary
The team discussed an AI-driven experimentation automation strategy, proposing a V1 launch where users can trigger feature creation and receive AI guidance throughout experiment lifecycles. Key features include integrating review agents for metadata validation, daily automated health checks of running experiments, and modular AI services to accommodate diverse customer needs. Significant challenges were identified, such as automating segment-level analysis due to data fragmentation and the necessity for a dedicated AI experimentation owner. The Slack app was highlighted as a central component awaiting review, essential for delivering AI-driven experiment interactions. The group emphasized a phased approach for deployment and the importance of clear deliverables to align efforts and resources for the upcoming 5.2 release.

## Keywords
AI automation, experiment lifecycle, Slack app, review agents, experiment analysis, product roadmap
